items.text: Saxony's fines catalogue (in force 1 July 2024): consuming in the immediate presence of minors €300 to €1,000 (about A$477 to about A$1,589); consuming in banned zones €100 to €500; carrying over 25 g up to 30 g away from home €250 to €1,000. Police and council officers enforce.
